tips.text: Run south to Camp Taurajo.
Mankrik at the Crossroads offers Lost in Battle. The beaten corpse is at 49.33, 50.32, on the way toward Camp Taurajo. Skip Her Name Is Olgra after it; that one wants four quillboar drops.

sources.label: QuestieDB npc 10668 Beaten Corpse; quest 95774 pre 4921

tips.text: Do not rebind at Camp Taurajo yet. A later step hearths to the Crossroads. Rebind at the Camp Taurajo inn (45.6, 59.0) only after that hearth.
Cozy Sleeping Bag unlocks at 14 from the burnt tower south of Camp Taurajo, but the chain is 90+ minutes for +3% xp. Leave it until after 20.

Accept Ishamuhale from Jorn Skyseer

tips.text: After Ishamuhale, Jorn offers Enraged Thunder Lizards and then Cry of the Thunderhawk. Stormsnouts are at 48.92, 51.37 and a thunderhawk hatchling is at 46.76, 50.95. Stop before Mahren Skyseer.

segments.t: Accept Chol'aruk the Ravener from Gur'ak

tips.text: Forever elite (level 21) in the Thorn Hill lair. It is given by Gur'ak and pays 6,150 XP plus a weapon or shield. Bring a group of 2 or 3.
Hold the boss with its back to you so the others stay out of its swing.
Keep the tank up; there are adds near the lair.
Kill the adds first, then the boss.

segments.t: Complete Chol'aruk the Ravener

tips.text: Thorn Hill lair, with a group.

segments.t: Complete Ishamuhale

tips.text: Ishamuhale is a named raptor; the quest database has no fixed spawn for him, so follow the in-game quest text.

segments.t: Turn in Chol'aruk the Ravener to Gur'ak

tips.text: Hand in to Gur'ak.

segments.t: Turn in Raptor Horns to Mebok Mizzyrix

tips.text: Fly to Ratchet at 20 to hand in Raptor Horns and pick up the elite shark quest.

segments.t: Accept WANTED: Bruuz from WANTED

tips.text: Forever elite (20) shark quest from Gazlowe in Ratchet. Group up; it gives 1,950 XP and Ratchet reputation.
Bruuz is in the water; pull him to the shore so the group can stand on land.
Stay behind him and save cooldowns for the start of the fight.

segments.t: Complete WANTED: Bruuz

tips.text: Do it with the group you formed for the other elites.

Accept Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected from Grunt Logmar

tips.text: Forever elite quest at the Dustwallow border. Bring a friend or do it at 21-22.
Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected needs level 18, so it comes after the Mura Runetotem turn-in, right before the last grind south of Camp Taurajo.
Pull the soldiers one at a time and fight with a wall behind you.
Do this with a group; the soldiers come in pairs.
Kill the casters first, and use crowd control on the second soldier.

segments.t: Complete Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected

tips.text: Dustwallow border south-east of Camp Taurajo, with a group.

segments.t: Turn in Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected to Grunt Logmar

Kill Stormsnouts south of Camp Taurajo until you reach 20. That closes the gap on worst-case experience: no rested, no food, dungeons off. If you are already 20 from bonuses or from Ragefire, Ruins of Lordaeron, and Wailing Caverns, skip it.
